stories.title: Celine Dion makes long-awaited return to stage in Paris

en.title: Celine Dion makes long-awaited return to stage in Paris
en.summary: The 58-year-old French-Canadian singer performed her first full concert in six years in Paris after battling a rare neurological disorder, drawing 30,000 fans to a sold-out venue.

stories.title: ‘Woman Unknown’ wins Gold Lion at Venice Film Festival

en.title: 'Woman Unknown' wins Gold Lion at Venice Film Festival
en.summary: Danish filmmaker May el-Toukhy's post-war drama won the Golden Lion and best actress award at Venice Film Festival, despite el-Toukhy being the only woman directing a feature in the main competition.

stories.title: 菲律宾客船起火事故死亡人数升至76人

en.title: Death toll from Philippine passenger ship fire rises to 76
en.summary: Philippine Coast Guard reported 41 additional bodies found on the burning vessel near Palawan province, raising confirmed deaths to 76, with 13 still missing and 43 rescued.

stories.title: 当物流装上“AI引擎” 如何跑出新速度？

en.title: How logistics equipped with 'AI engine' achieves new speed
en.summary: Artificial intelligence is transforming traditional logistics operations to enable efficient package circulation and precise delivery, as demonstrated at a service trade expo.

stories.title: Anthropic boss Amodei calls for AI slowdown, Altman and Musk agree

en.title: Anthropic boss Amodei calls for AI slowdown, Altman and Musk agree
en.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has called for artificial intelligence companies to slow development of powerful AI systems due to concerns about superintelligent computer risks. OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk have agreed with this position.

stories.title: 丁俊晖止步2026斯诺克英格兰公开赛四强

en.title: Ding Junhui eliminated in 2026 World Snooker English Open semifinals
en.summary: Ding Junhui lost 2-6 to Ali Carter in the 2026 World Snooker English Open semifinals and failed to reach the final. Carter secured four consecutive frames in the second half to advance.

stories.title: 新华图讯｜习近平会见印度总理莫迪

en.title: Xi Jinping meets with Indian Prime Minister Modi
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping met with Indian Prime Minister Modi in New Delhi on September 12.

stories.title: 习近平会见印度总理莫迪

en.title: Xi Jinping meets with Indian Prime Minister Modi
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping met with Indian Prime Minister Modi in New Delhi on September 12 during the 18th BRICS leaders summit. The two leaders exchanged views and reached important consensus on partnership.

stories.title: Bulgaria probes explosion at weapon storage site

en.title: Bulgaria probes explosion at weapon storage site
en.summary: Bulgarian authorities are investigating a fire at a weapons storage facility operated by EMCO, examining potential sabotage and possible connections to an earlier August incident at another company facility. No injuries were reported from the blaze near Tsareva Livada.

stories.title: 中国男篮大胜巴林队 提前晋级亚运会八强

en.title: China men's basketball team defeats Bahrain, advances to Asian Games quarterfinals
en.summary: China's men's basketball team won decisively 105-59 against Bahrain on September 12 during group play at the 20th Asian Games in Nagoya, Japan. The victory secured their advancement to the quarterfinals with two consecutive group wins.

stories.title: 39 pupils and staff fall ill after eating school lunches in Sha Tin

en.title: 39 pupils and staff fall ill after eating school lunches in Sha Tin
en.summary: Hong Kong health authorities are investigating suspected food poisoning affecting 39 people at Baptist Lui Ming Choi Primary School in Sha Tin who consumed school lunches on Wednesday. The affected individuals, including 37 students aged 5-11 and two staff members, developed gastrointestinal symptoms within 8-22 hours.

stories.title: 李鸿忠赴俄罗斯出席第七届中俄中小企业实业论坛并访问伊尔库茨克州

en.title: Li Hongzhong visits Russia to attend 7th China-Russia SME Business Forum and visits Irkutsk Oblast
en.summary: Li Hongzhong, a Chinese Communist Party Politburo member and vice chairman of the National People's Congress Standing Committee, attended the opening of the 7th China-Russia SME Business Forum in Moscow from September 9-12 and met with Russian officials before visiting Irkutsk Oblast.

stories.title: How AI tools are reshaping stock trading, investment research in China

en.title: How AI tools are reshaping stock trading, investment research in China
en.summary: Quantitative traders in China are increasingly using artificial intelligence tools to automate research and data analysis tasks. AI agents now help investors collect historical data and analyze market patterns to inform trading decisions more quickly than traditional manual methods.

stories.title: Taobao’s ‘ugly’ goods find a growing market among China’s young consumers

en.title: Taobao's 'ugly' goods find a growing market among China's young consumers
en.summary: Unconventional and quirky products have become increasingly popular with young Chinese consumers on Taobao, with cumulative sales exceeding 230 million yuan since the platform's 2020 Uglies Award launch celebrating creatively unusual goods.

stories.title: Private equity’s Fang Fenglei on investing in China, capital market reforms

en.title: Private equity's Fang Fenglei on investing in China, capital market reforms
en.summary: Fang Fenglei, chairman of Hopu Investments, has played a major role in shaping China's capital markets over three decades, including helping establish the country's first joint venture investment bank and facilitating listings of state-owned companies in Hong Kong.

stories.title: ‘Key pillar’: the 5-year powerhouse plan for China’s car industry

en.title: 'Key pillar': the 5-year powerhouse plan for China's car industry
en.summary: China's 15th five-year plan aims to establish the country as a global automotive leader by 2030 through boosting domestic sales and technological innovation in intelligent connected new-energy vehicles, while introducing mechanisms to prevent disorderly competition.

stories.title: Beijing freezes plant approvals for energy-storage batteries amid overcapacity fears

en.title: Beijing freezes plant approvals for energy-storage batteries amid overcapacity fears
en.summary: Chinese regulators have halted approvals for new energy-storage battery production facilities since May to address overcapacity concerns and prevent excessive price competition despite global demand from renewable-energy projects.
